title: Pigeonhole rack
subject: a tall freestanding oak rack of square pigeonholes, five rows of four, about two metres tall, each hole stuffed with rolled parchment maps and folded letters tied with string and closed with red wax seals, plain plank sides and a heavy base, no writing visible anywhere

title: Lectern
subject: a plain oak standing lectern with a steep slanted reading desk and a ledge, on a heavy post and a cross foot, an open thick ledger lying on it seen at a steep angle so no writing can be read, a ribbon marker

title: Map chest
subject: a low wide oak plan chest of six wide shallow drawers for keeping maps flat, each drawer with two plain forged iron drop handles, plank top worn at the edges, a rolled map lying on top

title: Iron-bound chest
subject: a heavy medieval oak strongbox chest bound with flat forged iron straps and big nail heads, a hasp and a plain iron lock plate, iron ring handles at the ends, the lid closed

title: Window seat cushion
subject: a long flat worn wool cushion for a stone window seat, faded madder red cloth with a darker woven border band, a little sagging and creased

title: Floor candle stand
subject: a tall wrought-iron floor candle stand about one and a half metres tall on a three-legged foot, a plain twisted shaft, a wide drip pan on top with one thick tallow candle and dripped wax

title: Wall sconce
subject: a plain forged iron wall candle sconce: a flat iron back plate with two curved arms each holding a drip pan and a tallow candle, mounted on a rough stone wall

title: Rug
subject: a worn medieval woollen floor rug seen from directly above, plain madder red and undyed wool in a simple border of bands, faded and thin in the middle where it is walked on, frayed fringed ends, no pattern of figures, no text

title: Scroll basket
subject: a round wicker basket standing on the floor filled with rolled parchment maps standing upright, some tied with string, no writing visible

title: Easel
subject: a plain sturdy oak easel for a large notice board: three square legs, a cross bar and a deep ledge to rest the board on, pegged joints, no board on it

title: Tapestry
subject: a faded medieval woollen wall tapestry of a royal hunt in a forest, riders with hounds and a stag among stylised trees, a border of leaves, the colours muted madder red, woad blue and weld yellow faded toward brown, coarse woven texture, no text, no lettering

title: Side table with ink
subject: a small plain oak side table with three goose quill pens, a horn inkwell, a sand shaker, a stick of red sealing wax and a short stack of folded blank papers, nothing written on anything

title: Paired lancet window
subject: a pair of tall narrow pointed lancet windows under one stone arch seen face-on from inside a dim room, glazed with small diamond panes of pale uneven greenish crown glass held in dark lead cames, bright overcast sky and a hint of green fields seen blurred through the glass, the deep stone reveal around them
